verdict.rationale: LangGraph's docs explicitly support multiple stream modes (updates, values, messages, custom, checkpoints, tasks, debug) via stream/astream methods, including a dedicated 'messages' mode for token streaming and separate iterators for events/subgraphs/output, directly matching the story of streaming tokens and intermediate agent events to a UI. A community comment notes streaming requires substantial client-side implementation work, suggesting some rough edges. Missing for 10: independent hands-on UI-integration examples/corroboration beyond docs, and confirmation that tool-call/step-level events are cleanly separated from token deltas in practice.
